title: Buddy Petit's augmenteds, elevenths and flatted fifths
summary: Buddy made augmented and minor sevenths chords on tunes like High Society; the interviewers also ask about flatted fifths locally.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, did Buddy play augmenteds and minor sevens?

Did Buddy play augmenteds and minor sevens? Yeah, make all them. Would he make elevens? Yeah. What he used to do when we played them hard, the bandstands would be way upstate. Buddy go down there, and after a while we'd be playing, and come in to the front door blowing these hards. You know what I used to do. Then after Buddy starts, all the rest of the quarter playing started out there. Sure does sound pretty, you know. Turn that middle to the floor and blow, you know. And people would be all dancing around it like that. What tune would he play when he did that? He said, what tune would he be playing when he was doing that? Different things, high society, the blues, and sophisticated lady, and all like that, you know. Would Buddy make elevens? Did he think he'd be playing? Yeah. Sure does sound pretty, you know. Sure does sound pretty, you know. Cause that middle to the floor and blow, you know. And people would be all dancing around it like that.
What tune would he play when he did that?
He said, what tune would he be playing when he was doing that? Different things, high society, the blues, and sophisticated lady, and all like that, you know.
Would Buddy make elevens, did he tell me about that? Yeah.
Elevens and thirteens. No, no, no. He said, did Buddy used to make elevens and thirteens? Ron? No, I didn't think he did. No, never did make them.
He said, what about flatted fifths? Fifth? You used to make them two, I used to make them two fifth cards.
Flatted fifths. Cover? Flat, flat, flatted fifths. Flat, flatted. Flat? Yeah. Flatted fifths.
Like, like you'd run C, E, and then you'd make a G. Only you'd flat the G. Did they do that down here?
Did they do that? But make a, what is? C, E, G. C, E, G. But they'd flat the G. Oh, C, E, G. And flatten the G. And make the flat, flat the G.
Yeah, would they do that? I see. Is that, is that late or early? When they did that. When they did that. Late years? Late years or early years?
